svg.title: Broker Capacity Without Losing Control of Consumption
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-reserved-capacity-to-collected-cash; chart type: process_flow; title: Broker Capacity Without Losing Control of Consumption; subtitle: Five operating stages connect supplier rights to reconciled customer usage.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operator resells only contractually authorized capacity. Prepayment controls credit exposure but does not eliminate chargebacks, supplier commits, or service-credit obligations.; caption: Keep gross customer billings, upstream supplier charges, and retained contribution in separate ledger accounts. A customer's wallet deposit is not earned service revenue before delivery.; stages: label: Secure supply rights; value: Document capacity, resale rights, and supplier limits; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Negotiate GPU reservation windows, carrier termination rates, IPv4 lease authority, cancellation terms, and measurable SLAs. Track minimum commits separately from consumed units.; label: Screen and fund; value: Identify buyers before activating prepaid consumption limits; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify business identity and intended workloads, enforce the AUP, and fund a Stripe-backed internal credit ledger. Reject abusive mining, spoofing, and unauthorized calling.; label: Route and isolate; value: Allocate eligible workloads within explicit spend ceilings; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use LiteLLM or vLLM for supported inference paths and least-cost routing for eligible SIP routes. Apply tenant isolation, destination restrictions, and tested failover limits.; label: Meter and reconcile; value: Match customer usage with independent supplier records; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Combine request-level token records, scheduler allocation intervals, DCGM health telemetry, and carrier call-detail records. DCGM utilization alone is not a billing ledger.; label: Collect and rebalance; value: Recognize delivered service and reset exposure daily; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Debit wallets idempotently, recognize delivered units, reconcile supplier invoices, and stop consumption at limits. Reprice expiring GPU reservations before generation-driven price compression erases their spread.
